items.description: The plan rewrote and added `gh api` lines in refs/create.md, refs/labels.md, SKILL.md and issue-worker-t3.md (Tasks 2, 3, 5) but had no task to update the exact-line classification table in tests/skills/test_worker_contract.py and only gated on test_issue_protocol.py, so two worker-contract tests stayed red through FINAL pass and the parent session had to fix the table after implement.

The plan named the Complexity read-back call but not how to match its result; the built rule only said to flag the value when 'absent', while the real GET returns a numeric option id in `value` and the name in `single_select_option.name`, so refs/labels.md had to be clarified (match by issue_field_id, compare single_select_option.name) during submission preparation, after implement.
